data: Does accuracy consistently decrease with constituent height after the peak?

The top graph shows the accuracy of constituent height in unbiased trees derived from the syntactic task distances in our model. The bottom graph shows the accuracy of constituent height in unbiased trees derived from the language modeling distances. Both graphs show the accuracy of constituent height on the y-axis and constituent height on the x-axis.

Looking at the top graph, we can see that the accuracy peaks around constituent height 3 and then decreases gradually. However, there is no consistent decrease after the peak. Instead, the accuracy fluctuates slightly before decreasing more significantly towards the end of the graph.

Looking at the bottom graph, we can see that the accuracy peaks around constituent height 1 and then decreases gradually. Similar to the top graph, there is no consistent decrease after the peak. Instead, the accuracy fluctuates slightly before decreasing more significantly towards the end of the graph.

In conclusion, the accuracy does not consistently decrease with constituent height after the peak in either graph.
